description: This source file implements a Node.js MCP proxy utility that intercepts and rewrites JSON-encoded lines, injecting MCP server information into specific methods, and spawning child processes to handle command execution based on decoded payloads.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract and decode the --payload parameter, returning an object with targetCommand and mcpServers.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines if a given method requires MCP server injection based on method name.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Attempts to parse a line as JSON and, if it matches specific criteria, injects MCP server information into its parameters.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks if the current script is the main module being executed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes the MCP proxy, spawning a child process, and setting up line-by-line input/output handling.
